title: Metabolic effects of carbon-plated running shoes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
publisher: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
claims: Advanced footwear technology commonly combines compliant, resilient foam with a full-length carbon fiber plate that increases longitudinal bending stiffness.
Whether the plate itself produces metabolic benefits is debated.

The systematic review and meta-analysis found carbon-plated shoes associated with lower metabolic demand across running-economy measures, while individual responses and study limitations remain relevant.
The review assessed metabolic outcomes and states that the plate contribution cannot be fully disentangled from midsole foam and geometry; it did not assess injury outcomes.

verification.note: 碳板鞋综述全文；2026-11-20 去掉未评估的伤害结局结论，只写代谢结局与归因限制。

claimVerification.note: 原文摘要：“Advanced footwear technology (AFT) commonly combines compliant, resilient foams with a full-length carbon fiber plate that increases longitudinal bending stiffness (LBS).”
原文摘要：“Whether the plate itself yields metabolic benefits remains debated.”

原文结论：“carbon-plated running shoes were associated with lower metabolic demand across running economy, metabolic cost, oxygen consumption, and energetic cost of transport, by approximately 2.75%”；限制段承认方法学异质性、性别失衡和体重调节反应。
原文评估代谢结局，并明确“the specific contribution of the plate cannot be fully disentangled from that of midsole foam and geometry”；综述没有伤害结局。原 claim 的“不预防伤害”是追加结论。
